problem_statement: The number utilities provide a divide-and-round-to-closest helper but no helper that performs integer division rounding up. Add a divide-and-round-up utility usable as DivideAndRoundUp(aDividend, aDivisor) over unsigned integer operands, returning the integer quotient rounded up: for example DivideAndRoundUp(2,1)==2, DivideAndRoundUp(1,3)==1, DivideAndRoundUp(2,3)==1, DivideAndRoundUp(3,2)==2, DivideAndRoundUp(11,10)==2, and DivideAndRoundUp(0,10)==0.
